item.title: How Environmental Triggers Enhance Healthcare Simulation Learning Outcomes
item.description: Environmental triggers are a powerful yet often overlooked method to introduce real-world complexity into healthcare simulations. Unlike patients or family members, environmental triggers are scripted elements that function within the system rather than as part of the clinical interaction itself. The environmental triggers might represent equipment that malfunctions intermittently, administrative gatekeeping, workflow bottlenecks, missing supplies, […]

item.title: The Role of Healthcare Simulation in the Reduction of Medical Errors
item.description: The pursuit of patient safety remains the primary driver for innovation within the healthcare simulation community. Medical errors pose a significant challenge for healthcare systems worldwide and often result from communication breakdowns, technical failures, or poor situational awareness. Clinical simulation provides a controlled environment where professionals practice high-stakes procedures without risk to a live patient. […]

item.title: Will AI Reduce the Role of Healthcare Simulation Educators?
item.description: Will Artificial Intelligence (AI) reduce the role of the healthcare simulation educator?
